stretch.name: Heel and calf stretch
stretch.help: Improves ankle mobility and reduces knee strain
stretch.how: Lean forward with one leg back and heel down, and the stair stretch, which involves hanging your heels off a step. Hold these stretches for 20-40 seconds, repeating 3-5 times per leg

stretch.name: Leg curl (quadriceps stretch)
stretch.how: Pull your foot toward your glutes while standing or laying down

stretch.name: Hamstring stretch
stretch.how: Sit on the floor with both legs out straight. Reach forward by bending at the waist while keeping your knees straight, holding for 15–30 seconds.

stretch.name: Single hamstring stretch
stretch.help: Targets one leg at a time
stretch.how: Sit on the floor with one leg extended and the other bent in. Keep your back straight and hinge forward from your hips toward the extended foot until you feel a pull.

stretch.name: Straight leg stretch
stretch.how: Lie on your back, lift head/shoulders, extend one leg up (grabbing the calf/thigh) and the other out. Pulse the top leg toward you twice, then switch legs, exhaling with each pull

stretch.name: Forward fold
stretch.how: It can be performed seated or standing, usually by hinging at the hips and reaching toward the feet. Hold for 15-60 seconds

stretch.name: Leg cross
stretch.how: Start by sitting crossed legged. Begin to lean forwards leading with your hands. Crawl your hands forwards to deepen the stretch. Hold this position for 20-30 seconds while focusing on relaxing breaths

stretch.name: Butterfly
stretch.how: Sit on a yoga mat with a tall spine, knees bent, and the soles of your feet touching. Bring your feet as close to your groin as comfortable, holding your ankles or feet. Inhale, then exhale while gently pushing the knees toward the floor. Maintain a straight back, or slowly hinge forward at the hips to deepen the stretch, allowing your elbows to rest on your thighs, not directly on the knees.  Hold the position for 30 seconds to two minutes

stretch.name: Standing adductor stretch
stretch.how: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward, and hands on hips or for balance.Shift your body weight to one side, bending the knee of that leg, while keeping the other leg completely straight. Keep the straight leg's foot flat on the floor to feel a stretch along the inner thigh of the extended leg. Maintain the position for 15–30 seconds, breathing deeply

stretch.name: Kneeling quad stretch
stretch.how: start in a half-kneeling position with one knee down and the other foot forward. Tighten your glutes and tuck your pelvis under, then gently shift your weight forward to feel a stretch in the front of your hip and thigh. Hold for 20-30 seconds, repeating on both sides

stretch.name: Couch stretch
stretch.how: Kneel on the floor with your back against a couch or wall. Place your right knee in the corner, with your shin running up the back cushion. Step your left foot forward into a lunge, with your knee at a 90-degree angle. Attempt to bring your torso upright, squeezing the glute of your rear leg. Hold the position for 1–2 minutes per side, breathing deeply.

stretch.name: Reclined hip twist
stretch.how: Lie on your back in a neutral position with arms stretched out to the sides, palms down. Bend your knees and bring them toward your chest, then drop both knees to the left side. Keep your shoulder blades pressed against the floor, even if it means lifting your knees higher.  Hold for 3–5 deep breaths, then inhale, return to center, and repeat on the other side

stretch.name: Hip flexor stretch
stretch.how: Kneel on your right knee, left foot flat in front (90-degree angle). Keep your back straight and push your hips forward gently. For more intensity, squeeze the glute of the trailing leg and raise the same-side arm.

stretch.name: Ankle twist with band
stretch.how: Sit with legs straight. Loop the band around the outside of the affected foot and anchor the other end, or hold it with the opposite hand. Pull the foot inward against the resistance and slowly release.

stretch.name: Seated figure 4 stretch
stretch.how: Sit tall in a chair, cross one ankle over the opposite knee, keep the foot flexed, and gently lean forward with a straight back until a stretch is felt. Hold for 15-30 seconds, repeating 2-4 times per side

stretch.name: Muscle stretch (knee push)
stretch.how: Start on your hands and knees, with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, and shoulders directly above your hands. Lean forward slightly so your body forms a straight line from head to knees, keeping legs together and engaging the glutes. Lower the body until upper arms are parallel to the ground, targeting a 90-degree angle at the elbows, then push back up while exhaling

stretch.name: Leg stretch (knee to chest)
stretch.how: Lie on your back, bend your knees with feet flat, and pull one knee toward your chest for 15–30 seconds while keeping the lower back pressed down. Repeat 2–4 times per leg, alternating sides

stretch.name: Double knee to chest
stretch.help: Relieves lower back and knee tension
stretch.how: Lie on your back, bend your knees with feet flat, and pull both knees toward your chest for 15–30 seconds while keeping the lower back pressed down. Repeat 2–4 times

stretch.name: IT band stretch
stretch.how: Stand with your feet together. Cross your right leg over your left, placing the right foot outside the left. Reach down toward your toes until you feel a stretch in the outer right hip/thigh. Hold for 30 seconds and repeat 5 times on each side.

strength.name: Knee extension
strength.how: Sit on a chair or bench and straighten your leg, focusing on squeezing the front thigh muscle. Place a resistance band around a secure post and behind the knee, stepping back to create tension. Slowly straighten the knee against the band.

strength.name: Knee flexion
strength.how: Sit on a chair or stand and slide your foot backward, or use a towel under the foot to pull it back, holding the stretch.

strength.name: Straight-leg raise
strength.how: Lie on your back on a firm surface, such as a floor or firm mattress. Bend one knee and place that foot flat on the floor, about 6 inches from your buttocks. Keep the other leg straight. Slowly lift your straight leg up until it is approximately the same height as your bent knee. Maintain the contraction and hold the leg in the air for about 5 to 10 seconds.

strength.name: Side leg raise
strength.how: Lie on your side, legs extended and stacked. Support your head with your lower arm, and keep your top hand on your hip or on the floor for stability. Slowly lift your top leg toward the ceiling, keeping it straight. Keep your toes pointed forward, not toward the ceiling, to isolate the hip muscles. Slowly lower the leg to the starting position without resting it completely on the bottom leg

strength.name: Prone leg raise
strength.how: Lie on your stomach, lift one straight leg 6–12 inches off the floor using glute strength, hold for 5 seconds, and lower slowly, keeping hips grounded to avoid back strain.

strength.name: Calf raise
strength.how: Start by standing with feet hip-width apart, slowly rising onto the balls of your feet, holding for one second, and lowering down slowly, repeating 8–15 reps per set

strength.name: Sit-to-stand
strength.how: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair with feet hip-width apart, lean forward slightly, and stand up using your legs (avoid using hands if possible)

strength.name: Step up
strength.how: . Stand facing a sturdy, knee-high bench, place one foot on top, and drive through the heel to stand up, avoiding pushing off with the back leg. Keep the torso upright, move in a slow, controlled manner, and alternate legs

strength.name: Squat
strength.how: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, chest proud, and core braced. Initiate the movement by pushing hips back as if sitting in a chair, lowering until thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping knees tracking over toes and heels planted, then drive through heels to stand.

strength.name: Wall squat
strength.how: Lean against a wall, feet hip-width apart, and lower until thighs are parallel to the floor (90-degree angle) for 15–60 seconds, keeping knees over ankles

strength.name: Bridging
strength.how: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. Exhale, engage your glutes, and lift your hips until your shoulders, hips, and knees align, then lower slowly

strength.name: Clamshell
strength.how: Lie on your side with hips stacked, knees bent and shoulders, hips, and ankles aligned. Rest your head on your bottom arm, and place your top hand on the floor or on your hip for stability. Squeeze your glutes, keep your heels together, and raise your top knee toward the ceiling, allowing only the hip to rotate. Slowly lower your top knee to the starting position with control. Perform 1–3 sets of 10–15 repetitions per side

other.name: Walking
other.how: Begin with short, 5-10 minute walks to build confidence. If you are inactive, start with a 15-minute easy walk 5 days a week to build consistency.

other.name: Running
other.how: Begin with a mix of walking and running (e.g., 30-second intervals) to allow tendons to adjust. Always include a 5-minute easy jog or dynamic stretches before, and light stretching after, to prevent injury. Aim for 3-4 days a week rather than one long, exhausting session
